description.zh: 添加的后端服务器列表，每次调用最多可删除20个后端服务器。
description.en: The list of backend servers that you want to remove. You can remove up to 20 backend servers at a time.
The IP address of the backend server.

description.zh: 负载均衡实例后端使用的端口。
description.en: The backend port that is used by the Edge Load Balancer (ELB) instance.
The instance ID of the backend server.

description.zh:
后端服务器类型。取值：
- **ens**：ENS实例。
- **eni**：弹性网卡实例。
description.en:
The type of backend server. Valid values:

- **ens**: an Edge Node Service (ENS) instance.

- **eni**: an Elastic Network Interface (ENI).
The weight of the backend server.
The ID of the Edge Load Balancer (ELB) instance.

descriptions.en:
- Rate limit: 100 requests per second.

- up to 10 times per second per account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens remove-backend-servers --load-balancer-id lb-5ovkn1piwqmoqrfjdyhq40000 --backend-servers Type=ens ServerId=i-5uf68ts0fqexe1a4n0000 Ip=192.168.0.1 Port=0 Weight=100 --region cn-hangzhou
